_note: Facts for the cloud session to READ. Nothing here goes into code; config examples use placeholders.

lan.router: Google Wifi 1st gen mesh - latency for every client degrades under this LAN's torrent load
lan.topology: workstation in the GARAGE, NUC ~100 ft away in the LIVING ROOM, no Ethernet run between them and none planned: at least one hop is the mesh's wireless backhaul. Design for a measured 1080p60 ~15 Mbps stream, not an assumed wired gigabit path
lan.ipv6: broken on this mesh (no working path out) - do not depend on IPv6; prefer IPv4 everywhere
lan.dhcp: all addresses are DHCP leases and DO change - never hard-code an IP; find the host by name/mDNS/ARP-by-MAC

media_server.role: Windows media server (Plex, the Cortex dashboard on :8500, this brief's author runs there). It will SSH into the NUC to validate.
media_server.plex: http://192.168.86.248:32400 (optional future tile: Plex HTPC on the NUC - OUT OF SCOPE for v1)
media_server.ssh_public_key: installer/authorized_keys in this repo (ed25519, generated on the media server)

workstation.role: Windows 11 gaming workstation with a discrete GPU - the Sunshine HOST. Model/GPU/NIC/MAC not yet recorded; Michael provides them when the kit is run.
workstation.gamepad_dongle: Xbox-style gamepad with a USB dongle that works out of the box on this Windows 11 machine today; assumed to be the Microsoft Xbox Wireless Adapter (xone on Linux). Bluetooth fallback must exist.
workstation.powershell: 5.1 is the default shell there - every .ps1 must parse under 5.1 and be pure ASCII

nuc.model: UNKNOWN - Michael is buying/choosing; adapt at install time (vainfo decode caps -> default display mode)
nuc.tv_input: one dedicated HDMI input on the living-room TV (same TV as the Roku 'MKUltra', LAN 192.168.86.33)

existing_conventions.kid_readable_failure_screens: every failure state shows kid words plus a parent detail line (rule inherited from the Spin to Watch project)
existing_conventions.alerts: Michael already receives ntfy + Discord alerts from the media server; the NUC may POST to an ntfy URL read from /etc/couch/couch.toml - the URL is never in the repo
existing_conventions.no_metered_services: no API keys, no paid APIs, no cloud dependencies at runtime
